searched.title: Bambu Lab A1 3D Printer (store page)
searched.note: Parsed with the package (extractPage + buildImportPayload with the manifest row): A1 SPECS table (18 rows), Product Features and footnotes, description sections, What's in the box / A1 Combo Add-ons, FAQ, variant descriptions. The page's messages bundle holds no A1 keys (its 220V/UK keys are production.H2D's), so the only intl_220v value is the sheet's max power.

specs.note: The store table (Build Volume(W*D*H)) and the FAQ ("256 * 256 *256 mm³") state the same volume.

specs.locator: p.1, ToolHead › Max Hot End Temperature

specs.note: The store table row "Nozzle Diameter" ("0.4 mm (Included) / 0.2 mm, 0.6 mm, 0.8 mm") gives the same included 0.4 mm.

specs.locator: p.1, ToolHead › Nozzle Diameter (Included); Nozzle Diameter (Optional)
specs.quote: Nozzle Diameter (Included): 0.4 mm Nozzle Diameter (Optional): 0.2 mm, 0.6 mm, 0.8 mm
Compatible Build Plate: Bambu Textured PEI Plate Bambu Smooth PEI Plate Bambu High Temperature Plate (Smooth PEI) Bambu Cool Plate
specs.conflict: The store table (A1 SPECS › Heatbed › Build Plate) lists five plates: the same four plus "Bambu Dual-Texture PEI Plate", and marks the textured plate "(Included)" (kept here as printing.included_build_plate). The sheet is the December 2023 edition (file A1_Spec_EN_1214, PDF modified 2023-12-14). By source rank this four-plate list replaces the store's five-plate list; the Dual-Texture plate stays as a relation (store evidence). Needs owner review.

specs.note: The ℃ sign is set in an embedded SimSun GBK font (glyph code A1E6 = ℃, decoded from the page content stream) that pdftotext/poppler without the Adobe-GB1 pack drops, so the text layer and a poppler render show only "100". The store table states "100°C".

specs.value: Automatic: Z-offset, bed level, vibration resonance and nozzle pressure are calibrated for every print job
specs.quote: It meticulously calibrates the Z-offset, bed-level, vibration resonance and nozzle pressure for EVERY print job, automatically.

specs.value: Multi-color printing with one AMS lite (Combo version): up to 4 colors
specs.quote: The A1 can only support one AMS lite, which means it can print with a maximum of 4 colors.
specs.note: Product Features bullet 2: "Seamless Multi-Color Printing (Combo Version)". Other AMS units connect through the A1 Series AMS Hub (SA013), up to 4 AMS units (relations).

specs.quote: * Cybersecurity compliant with EU RED Article 3.3(d)(e) and ETSI EN 303 645 V2.1.1:2020.

relations.note: Variant "A1" description: "To connect AMS 2 Pro unit(s) to A1 series printer, an A1 series AMS Hub (SA013) is required." SA013 is the A1 Series AMS Hub (compat-targets requirement_targets "A1 series AMS Hub" → ams-hub-a1-series), not the SA002-N AMS Hub (ams-hub).

relations.quote: For drying function: One Switching Adapter is required for each AMS 2 Pro unit.
